purpose: Separate decoder learnability from the underdetermined twelve-component/five-band inverse problem
basis: Pinned FSPS component0 with continuous independent 0-5% component1 mixing; all other components zero
redshift: Original grid centers from0.1 to1.1, uniformly sampled
objects: 1024 unique training and256 independent validation SED mixtures, each observed through HSC and Legacy
optimization: Use already source-selected neighbor CE sigma3, AdamW0.002/weight decay0.0001, 2000 updates, seed11; identical label budget
evaluation: Source validation first; lock models before evaluating paired unseen full CLAUDS-like and new-only filter responses
limitations: Near-single-family matched physics is an elementary diagnostic, not realistic population transfer
